# Douyin

8 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 premium (10), 7 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Douyin, the Chinese domestic version of TikTok (a separate app and a separate content graph - a handle on one is not the same account on the other). Video search, creator profiles and their feeds, video detail, comments and comment replies, creator search, and the hot-search board. Most endpoints are METERED per row returned with wide bands (5-250cr), so always cap `limit` before you call and read `credits_used` for the settled charge.

## GET /v1/douyin/comment/replies - 5-250 credits (request-shaped)

Returns the reply thread under one Douyin comment: text, replier, like count, IP region and verification. Every row carries comment.parent_id set to the comment you asked about, so a thread reassembles without guesswork. Get the comment ID from GET /v1/douyin/post/comments.

**Use when** a comment shows a non-zero reply count and you need the conversation, not just the opening line.
**Cost** price moves with `limit` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per reply RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front - the default limit of 10 holds 50 and the 50 maximum holds 250 - and settles down to the replies actually delivered. Only a comment with a non-zero `engagement.replies` has a thread, so check that on the parent row before spending a call here.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Douyin video URL or the bare numeric aweme ID the comment sits under. · e.g. `https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369`
- `comment_id` (required) - The comment to expand, taken from the id field of a GET /v1/douyin/post/comments row. Only comments with a non-zero engagement.replies have a thread. · e.g. `7682735175344833317`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Replies to return, 1 to 50. Default 10. Each reply costs 5 credits and you are charged only for replies returned.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block. Omit for the first page.

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.author.username` | Comment author username (null when tombstoned) |
| `comment.parent_id` | Parent comment ID for nested replies, or null for… |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |

+8 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.url`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/comment/replies" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369" \
  --data-urlencode "comment_id=7682735175344833317" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/post - 10 credits (premium)

Returns one Douyin video from its URL or aweme ID: caption, creator, likes, comments, shares, saves, hashtags, music, duration, dimensions, cover image and the tagged place when the creator added one. Richer than a search row: this surface carries the creator's total likes and video count, plus the point-of-interest block. Douyin publishes no view counts, so post.engagement.views is null.

**Use when** you already have a video URL and want the full record. Search rows carry less: no place and no creator totals.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Douyin video URL, for example https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369, or the bare numeric aweme ID. · e.g. `https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+17 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.engagement.views`.

**Next** `douyin/post/comments` (`url` ← `data.post.url`) - The comments on the video.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/post/comments - 2-100 credits (request-shaped)

Returns top-level comments on a Douyin video: text, commenter, like count, reply count, the commenter's IP region, and whether the creator liked the comment. Top-level only. To read a thread call GET /v1/douyin/comment/replies with the comment ID from these rows.

**Use when** you want to read audience reaction to a video. To open one thread, call the replies endpoint with that comment id.
**Cost** price moves with `limit` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 1 credit per comment RETURNED, with a floor of 2. The call holds `limit x 1` up front - the default limit of 20 holds 20 and the 100 maximum holds 100 - and settles down to the comments actually delivered, so a video with four comments does not cost a twenty-comment request.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxCommentsPerPost is a cap, probed 2026-09-08: limit=4 and limit=8 honoured exactly, no page token in the schema or the body. Deeper reads raise limit, up to 100.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Douyin video URL or the bare numeric aweme ID. · e.g. `https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Comments to return, 1 to 100. Default 20. Each comment costs 1 credit and you are charged only for comments returned.

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |
| `comment.author.avatar_url` | URL to comment author profile picture |
| `comment.author.display_name` | Comment author display name |

+6 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `comment.author.username`, `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.parent_id`, `comment.url`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/post/comments" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.douyin.com/video/7681266289940544369" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/profile - 6 credits (custom)

Returns one Douyin creator: nickname, Douyin ID, bio, avatar, follower and following counts, total likes received, video count, IP region and verification status. Accepts a profile URL, a bare sec_uid, or the numeric user ID. This is the cheapest way to track a follower count on Douyin. For the creator's videos call GET /v1/douyin/profile/posts.

**Use when** you want to track a creator's follower count over time. It is the cheapest Douyin call, because it fetches no videos.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Douyin sec_uid, the MS4wLjAB... string in a profile URL, or the numeric user ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Douyin profile URL, for example https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAA... · e.g. `https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAtxsy7VmVkU3RN9oIX0vdkh_6-LlQAb0gwI-tDf-bYNg`
- `id` (optional, string) - Numeric Douyin user ID.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `url`, `id`.

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+10 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `author.joined_at`, `author.private`.

**Next** `douyin/profile/posts` (`handle` ← `data.author.username`) - List a Douyin creator's videos.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAtxsy7VmVkU3RN9oIX0vdkh_6-LlQAb0gwI-tDf-bYNg" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/profile/posts - 5-125 credits (request-shaped)

Returns a Douyin creator's recent videos with caption, likes, comments, shares, saves, hashtags, music and cover image, newest first. Narrow the window with recent_days, or drop pinned posts with exclude_pinned to read genuine recent activity. Douyin publishes no view counts, so post.engagement.views is null.

**Use when** you want to read a creator's posting cadence. Set exclude_pinned to true so an old pinned video does not distort recent activity.
**Cost** price moves with `limit` · cache 900 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per row RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front - the default limit of 10 holds 50 and the 25 maximum holds 125 - and settles down to the videos actually delivered, so a creator with 4 recent videos costs 20 credits however high `limit` was set. `recent_days` and `exclude_pinned` narrow the result set BEFORE billing settles, so they lower the charge as well as the noise.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxResultsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-08: limit=1 and limit=5 honoured, no page token in the schema or the body. Deeper reads raise limit, up to 25.

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Douyin sec_uid, the MS4wLjAB... string in a profile URL, or the numeric user ID.
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Douyin profile URL. · e.g. `https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAtxsy7VmVkU3RN9oIX0vdkh_6-LlQAb0gwI-tDf-bYNg`
- `id` (optional, string) - Numeric Douyin user ID.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Rows to return, 1 to 25. Default 10. Each row costs 5 credits and you are charged only for rows returned.
- `recent_days` (optional, integer, 1-3650) - Only return videos published in the last N days. Leave unset for the newest regardless of age.
- `exclude_pinned` (optional, boolean) - Set true to skip videos pinned to the top of the profile, which can be old.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `url`, `id`.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+19 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.engagement.views`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `douyin/post/comments` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get Douyin video comments. · `douyin/post` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Douyin video.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/profile/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAAtxsy7VmVkU3RN9oIX0vdkh_6-LlQAb0gwI-tDf-bYNg" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/search - 5-125 credits (request-shaped)

Returns Douyin videos matching a keyword: caption, creator, likes, comments, shares, saves, hashtags, music, cover image and duration. Chinese, English and mixed queries all work. Douyin does not publish view counts outside its own app, so post.engagement.views is always null on every Douyin endpoint. For creators rather than videos call GET /v1/douyin/search/users.

**Use when** you want to track a topic or brand across Douyin. For the creators behind the videos, call the creator search instead.
**Cost** price moves with `limit` · cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Pricing** 5 credits per row RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front - the default limit of 10 holds 50 and the 25 maximum holds 125 - and settles down to the rows actually delivered, so a narrow query that returns 3 videos costs 15 credits however high `limit` was set.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxResultsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-08: limit=1 and limit=5 honoured, no page token in the schema or the body. Deeper reads raise limit, up to 25.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example 美食 or coffee. · e.g. `美食`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Rows to return, 1 to 25. Default 10. Each row costs 5 credits and you are charged only for rows returned.
- `sort` (optional, enum: relevance | most_liked | latest) - Result ordering: relevance, most_liked, or latest. Default relevance.
- `published` (optional, enum: all | day | week | half_year) - Recency window: all, day, week, or half_year. Default all.
- `duration` (optional, enum: all | under_1m | one_to_five_m | over_5m) - Length filter: all, under_1m, one_to_five_m, or over_5m. Default all.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+19 more fields in the full schema. Never filled: `post.engagement.views`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `douyin/post/comments` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get Douyin video comments. · `douyin/post` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Douyin video.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=美食" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/search/users - 5-125 credits (request-shaped)

Returns Douyin creators matching a keyword: nickname, Douyin ID, bio, follower count, total likes received, avatar, profile URL and verification label. Filter by follower band or by account type to shortlist creators for outreach. This endpoint paginates: pass the returned cursor to walk deeper.

**Use when** you want to shortlist creators for outreach. Narrow by follower band or account type before you spend calls on full profiles.
**Cost** price moves with `limit` · cache 120 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per creator RETURNED. The call holds `limit x 5` up front - the default limit of 10 holds 50 and the 25 maximum holds 125 - and settles down to the creators actually delivered.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** cursor · 10/page by default, max 25; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ N rows x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example 美食 or a brand name. · e.g. `美食`
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Rows to return, 1 to 25. Default 10. Each row costs 5 credits and you are charged only for rows returned.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Continuation token from a previous response's pagination block. Omit for the first page.
- `followers` (optional, enum: all | under_1k | 1k_to_10k | 10k_to_100k | 100k_to_1m | over_1m) - Follower band: all, under_1k, 1k_to_10k, 10k_to_100k, 100k_to_1m, or over_1m. Default all.
- `user_type` (optional, enum: all | regular_user | enterprise_verified | individual_verified) - Account type: all, regular_user, enterprise_verified, or individual_verified. Default all.

**Response** `AuthorList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ author }` ([full schema](schemas/AuthorList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+5 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `douyin/profile` (`handle` ← `data.items[].author.username`) - Get a Douyin creator profile.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/search/users" \
  --data-urlencode "query=美食" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/douyin/trending - 25 credits (custom)

Returns the live Douyin hot-search board (抖音热搜): roughly 50 trending topics with rank, hot value, view count, video count and the time the topic broke. This is the highest-signal short-form trend surface in mainland China. The whole board is returned in one call for one flat price.

**Use when** you want to see what mainland China is watching right now. One call returns the whole ranking, already ordered by rank.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - The hot-search board is a fixed ranked list of roughly 50 topics with no pagination of any kind. Probed 2026-09-08: the upstream row cap is inert and the full board returns every time.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): `event_time`, `hot_value`, `rank`, `video_count`, `view_count`, `word`.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/douyin/trending" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
